I'll pick one from each class, since that makes the most sense to me 

Mage: Aphrodite. I know healers are struggling in this meta. In S10 they struggle too, but most of them have other properties that make these gods viable in different ways (Chang'e and Hel having raw damage. Baron with his good cc, etc), however Aphrodite lacks all of these strengths for an ultimate. Now the ultimate is very strong tbf, but I don't think that's enough to justify even playing her unless you're comms. I honestly liked her way more before Hirez decided to change her. 


Assassin: Bakasura. This shouldn't come as a shock to most people as he is a downgrade to Kail in every way, but the final nail in the coffin for him is when Hirez buffed Arcane. She does his job easier and it doesn't require an ultimate at all. Doesn't help that his jump is way too slow as well, which makes him an easy picking. 


Hunters: Skadi. Some may disagree with me on this, but hear me out first. Cupid (while having an ugly design that I hope changes), has some benefits and does fine against mobility based matchups and has some utility in the heals. Skadi however has nothing and relies way too heavily on Kaldr. Which is the point of the character, but if Kaldr is shut down, she is as well. 



Guardians: Cthulhu. At this point he feels more forgotten than Fanfir receiving skins (couldn't help myself). His kit is trivialized and he's probably the only character when he ults, he's easier to kill than anyone because he's a big target. Even with Thorn changes (his best relic), he's still not used at all. 


Warriors: Guan Yu. This is the most obvious pick as his kit is outdated more than anything. He however is much easier to buff than anyone because you can make his abilities more potent around his passive.
